caption:
Thrustmaster's T-GT III goes on sale December 3 at an announced $749.99: a 5 Nm direct-drive base with peaks up to 10 Nm, a T-GT rim with four dials for Gran Turismo and a load-cell brake in the box, for PS5. The T598 has the same 5 Nm for about $600. Specs from the announcement, not a test. We earn from qualifying purchases. #granturismo7 #thrustmaster

The T-GT III's page, and what to compare it with: https://roomracer.com/parts/wheel-bases/thrustmaster-t-gt-iii?src=yt-answer
title: Thrustmaster T-GT III for PS5: what's in the box, from the announcement
